subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Return of Ads
description: A fast breakdown of The Return of Ads for builders.

hook.text: Streaming promised no ads. In 2022, Netflix and Disney+ both launched cheaper plans with commercials.

buildup.text: Subscriber growth was slowing. Platforms needed new revenue. Ads were the oldest trick in the television book.

discovery.text: Advertisers loved it. Streaming ads could be targeted by age, location, and viewing history—far better than cable.

twist.text: Most new Netflix subscribers now choose the ad-supported tier. The premium ad-free plan is becoming the minority.

climax.text: Streaming has come full circle. The medium that killed ads is now funded by them.

punchline.text: Streaming didn't kill ads. It just made them smarter.

quiz.question: Why did Netflix and Disney+ introduce ad-supported tiers?
options: Subscriber growth slowed and they needed new revenue
